easy.q: How old do you have to be to become U.S. president?
easy.fact: Theodore Roosevelt, at 42, was the youngest ever to take office.

easy.q: How many letters are in the word Mississippi?
easy.fact: Four S's, four I's, two P's and one M.

easy.q: How many Golden Girls were there?
easy.fact: Dorothy, Rose, Blanche and Sophia, from 1985 to 1992.

easy.q: What's a perfect score in bowling?
easy.fact: It takes 12 strikes in a row.

easy.q: How many sides does a stop sign have?
easy.fact: U.S. stop signs have been red octagons since 1954.

medium.q: How many Dragon Balls do you need to summon the dragon Shenron?
medium.fact: Collect them all and you get a wish.

medium.q: How many seconds did the Wright brothers' first powered flight last?
medium.fact: It covered 120 feet, less than a Boeing 747's wingspan.

medium.q: How many countries are completely surrounded by Italy?
How many years apart did Top Gun and Top Gun: Maverick come out?
medium.fact: Top Gun came out in 1986; Maverick, in 2022.

medium.q: The 1972 Dolphins went undefeated. How many games did they win, counting the playoffs?
medium.fact: They're still the NFL's only perfect season.

hard.q: How tall is the Burj Khalifa in Dubai, in feet?
hard.fact: It has been the world's tallest building since 2010.

hard.q: How many states did the U.S. have in 1900?
In 2006, LaDainian Tomlinson set the NFL record for touchdowns in a season. How many?
hard.fact: He scored 28 on the ground and 3 through the air.

hard.q: How many years did Johnny Carson host The Tonight Show?
hard.fact: He handed it to Jay Leno in 1992.
